prefix.description: The prefix in canonical CIDR text, e.g. "10.20.30.0/24" or "2001:db8::/104". The trie publishes it as the message key and as the envelope's subject, so the stats of one hot-ip event carry distinct event_ids (ADR-0017 decision 14).

hot_ratio.description: hot_count / capacity, computed exactly and rounded once to the nearest double. Informational: prefix classification compares hot_count and capacity exactly (ADR-0010 decision 1). Optional here; the trie sets it on every message it publishes (ADR-0017 Amendment 2).

sequence.description: The trie's event_sequence once it has applied the hot-ip event behind these stats: the offset of the next hot-ip record it will read (ADR-0017 decision 8). Shared by every stat of one event, strictly increasing from one event to the next, and not dense. A consumer applies a PrefixStatsChanged only if its sequence is greater than the one it holds for that prefix (ADR-0013 decision 9).

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the hot-ip event behind these stats, not the time they were published (ADR-0017 decision 14).
